source:
"Gifted".
That is how they refer to those who have special abilities, or "gifts".
You possess one of those strange "gifts".
Some try to use your gift for evil, forcing you into a desperate situation.
Than, all of a sudden...

"Hello there, I'm your savior!"

Three saviors appear before you.
